records.process_description: Students enrolled in the MA Major 90 or Mono 120 (Network Cinema CH) complete the Master by booking two modules independently: a one‑semester Fachüberblick (60‑min oral exam, typically CW 18–19 in FS or 48–49 in HS) and a two‑semester Masterarbeit. Choose and define your topic early, contact a prüfungsberechtigte Betreuungsperson (professors, postdocs, Oberassistierende or Privatdozierende listed on the FIWI team page) before booking, send an idea sketch and arrange a meeting; after acceptance agree on timeline and the timing of the module booking. Prepare a concept paper (ideally ≤8 pages excluding provisional outline, bibliography, filmography) with summary, question, theory, thesis, method and corpus. Regular attendance of the Master‑Kolloquium over two semesters (≈3–4 sessions/semester) is required. Binding rules and deadlines are on the Philosophical Faculty site (password‑protected masterarbeit area): https://www.phil.uzh.ch/de/studium/rundumsstudium/module.html.
